rules.title: Adjectives with -ous: dangerous, famous, nervous
rules.short_explanation: Many adjectives end in ous: dangerous, famous, nervous, serious, curious and delicious. Do not write ouse or us at the end.
rules.tts_text: Many adjectives end in o u s.
rules.mnemonic: Dangerous, famous, curious: they all finish with ous.

examples.text: The wet floor is dangerous.
She is a famous logistics expert.
He felt nervous before the interview.
This is a serious problem with delivery.
The child was curious about the robots.
The restaurant serves delicious food.
The warehouse has an enormous parking area.
She gave a generous discount to customers.
The road was dangerous in the fog.
He was curious about the new system.
The news made everyone nervous.
The wet floor is dangerus.
She is a famus logistics expert.
examples.correction: She is a famous logistics expert.

examples.text: He felt nervus before the interview.
examples.correction: He felt nervous before the interview.

examples.text: This is a seriouse problem with delivery.
examples.correction: This is a serious problem with delivery.
examples.note: Serious ends in ous, not ouse.

examples.text: The child was curius about the robots.
examples.correction: The child was curious about the robots.

examples.text: The restaurant serves delicous food.
The warehouse has an enormus parking area.
examples.correction: The warehouse has an enormous parking area.

examples.text: She gave a generouse discount to customers.
examples.correction: She gave a generous discount to customers.
examples.note: Generous ends in ous, not ouse.

examples.text: The road was dangerouse in the fog.
examples.correction: The road was dangerous in the fog.

examples.text: He was curiouse about the new system.
examples.correction: He was curious about the new system.

examples.text: The news made everyone nervouse.
The bus arrives at seven.
examples.note: Bus ends in us, not ous.

examples.text: The virus spread quickly last winter.
examples.note: Virus ends in us, not ous.

examples.text: Please check the status of the order.
examples.note: Status ends in us, not ous.
